# Copilot instructions for this portfolio

Treat this workspace as a premium product portfolio site for Daniel Genesis.

- Keep the experience polished, modern, and conversion-focused.
- Favor concise, high-impact copy and thoughtful visual details.
- Preserve the dark theme, teal accents, and subtle motion design.
- When editing content, make it feel more confident, clear, and useful for prospective clients.
- Verify changes by running npm run build from the portfolio-site folder.
